We need more accessible care, stronger systems, and updated treatment options.

For the second year in a row, Rory McIlroy wins the Masters, making history.

An incredible win, a tradition like no other.

Congratulations.

MACE WIN: We helped secure the LARGEST infrastructure grant in South Carolina history: $195 million to improve Long Point Road for the Port. 

This funding will strengthen access to the Port of Charleston, improve traffic flow and freight movement, and support jobs and economic growth across the Lowcountry. 

South Carolina STRONG.

MACE WIN: We supported the authorization of $30.4 MILLION for a new VA clinic coming to Beaufort County.

This new clinic will bring outpatient care closer to nearly 17,000 Lowcountry veterans. Our veterans should never have to travel far or wonder whether they can get the care they’ve earned.

South Carolina STRONG.

Time to clean House.

These members have proven through their own actions they are unfit to serve:

Sheila Cherfilus-McCormick
Tony Gonzales
Cory Mills
Eric Swalwell

They should resign IMMEDIATELY. If they don’t, we should expel all of them.

In the first session of the 119th Congress, we ranked 8th out of 435 members of the U.S. House for our major legislative achievements while securing big wins for South Carolina.

We introduced 65 bills, ranking first among the South Carolina delegation and in the top 2% of the entire House.

Two of our bills passed the House: the Preventing Violence Against Women by Illegal Aliens Act and the Federal Contractor Cybersecurity Vulnerability Reduction Act.

Clean house. Every last one of them.

Wanted to take a moment to recognize the courage of the women coming forward about their heinous experiences with Eric Swalwell.

BRAVE.

America is the land of the free and the home of the brave because of our incredible military.

From Operation Midnight Hammer to bringing our pilots home from hostile territory, our armed forces have shown the world America does not flinch and does not leave its people behind.

America First is not a slogan. It is a standard our military lives up to every single day.

To every service member, past and present, this country stands free because you gave everything for it. 🇺🇸

We are STILL missing SO MUCH information.

Where are all the videos and the logs kept in Epstein’s residences?

Congratulations to Chief Stephanie Price of the City of Beaufort Police Department for being selected for the 2026 Ted Poe Award for Excellence by a Public Official! 

Our office nominated Chief Price through the Survivors and Justice Caucus, and being chosen from a competitive pool proves what we already know: the Lowcountry is home to the best of the best. 

Chief Price sets the standard for excellence and our community is better for it. 

South Carolina STRONG.

MACE WIN: We helped secure authorization for $7.5 MILLION for wastewater and stormwater projects in Beaufort County.

Growth without infrastructure investment is a problem waiting to happen. This funding gets ahead of it. Clean water and better stormwater management keep our community prepared.

South Carolina STRONG.

MACE WIN: Our Protect American Fisheries Act will protect fishermen all around the country from anticompetitive foreign practices.

"NOAA's fishery disaster program must finally come to terms with the reality that imports completely dominate the U.S. market including for cod, haddock and other New England groundfish,” said Jackie Odell, Executive director of the Northeast Seafood Coalition. "Like so many U.S. fisheries, we need Rep. Mace's bill."

When our constituents need help, we do not waste time, we step in and get to work.

If you are a constituent who needs help navigating federal agencies or casework issues, please visit mace.house.gov/constituentse…

I don't care what party you're in. If you sexually assault or sexually harass your employee (or anyone), you have no business serving in Congress.

I called on Tony Gonzales to resign - now I'm calling on Eric Swalwell to resign.


San Francisco Chronicle (@sfchronicle)

April is Sexual Assault Awareness Month.

Sexual assault remains one of the most underreported crimes in the country. Many survivors stay silent out of fear: fear of not being believed, fear of retaliation, and fear the system will fail them, as it has so many before.

But survivors are not defined by what was done to them. They are defined by their courage to keep going, to speak up, and to refuse to let what happened be the end of their story.

To every survivor reading this: you are not alone

Another member of Congress facing heinous and disgusting sexual misconduct allegations and this time, it's Eric Swalwell. 

Four women. A former staffer says he raped her while she was heavily intoxicated and left her bleeding and bruised. Unsolicited nude photos. Sexual assault. One pattern.

An alleged predator has no business serving in Congress. Eric Swalwell must RESIGN immediately.

But still, no one has.

We are not letting this go. We are not backing down. And we will use every tool at our disposal to deliver justice for the victims of Jeffrey Epstein.
